name: Flipcash USDF
oneLiner: USDF is Flipcash's dollar stablecoin and the first Coinbase Custom Stablecoin, collateralized 1:1 by USDC via Coinbase's stablecoin-as-a-service platform.
collateral: 1:1 collateralized by USDC via Coinbase's Custom Stablecoins platform; reserves managed by Coinbase infrastructure
pegMechanism: Coinbase Custom Stablecoin model: Coinbase handles issuance, redemption, custody, security, and compliance; USDF is designed to maintain a stable U.S. dollar value and relies on Coinbase-managed reserve backing and redemption mechanics

genius.licensingRegulator: NYDFS virtual currency and money transmitter licenses; state money transmitter context
genius.notes: USDF is described as a Coinbase Custom Stablecoin backed 1:1 by USDC, but no token-specific GENIUS permitted-issuer or state-qualified approval source was located.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule and public releases
Public U.S. permitted-issuer, state-qualified, official-application, and foreign-exception materials
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Coinbase Custom Stablecoin and state-license materials were found, but no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for USDF.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDF resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

launchPhaseDetail: Debut token on Coinbase's Custom Stablecoin platform; went live 2026-05-20 on Solana, 1:1 backed by USDC, with Coinbase Onramp fiat access; serves as the settlement asset for Flipcash's user-created currencies; the on-chain reserve contract (github.com/code-payments/flipcash-program) was audited by Sec3. Not yet listed on DefiLlama or CoinGecko under the Flipcash identity and no public Solana mint address disclosed, so it cannot yet enter Pharos runtime data.
